Vendor record for `vendor/glad` (C2-008, P2-030)

- Package: `glad2` on PyPI (imports as `glad`), version **2.0.8**, generated with CPython 3.12.10.
  The generator itself is David Herberth's glad2 — https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad.
- Command line, verbatim (arg order matters: `--reproducible` and `--quiet` are top-level options and
  must precede the `c` subcommand):

  ```
  python -m venv /tmp/glad2-probe/v
  /tmp/glad2-probe/v/Scripts/python -m pip install glad==2.0.8
  /tmp/glad2-probe/v/Scripts/python -m glad --reproducible --quiet --api gl:core=3.3 --out-path /tmp/glad2-probe/gen c
  ```

- Specification pin: `--api gl:core=3.3` — the GL 3.3 Core profile, which is the minimum the render
  backend targets (`GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MAJOR 3` / `MINOR 3` with `GLFW_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE`).
- **No `--extensions` flag was passed.** The generator's default extension set for `gl:core=3.3`
  applies, which the generated header self-reports as `Extensions: 619` (`include/glad/gl.h` line 8).
  This is the default, not an explicit request for extra extensions — nothing outside the 3.3 Core
  spec was selected by hand. Only the loader entry points for the pinned API are compiled.
- Generated files, copied verbatim with no local modification:

  | Path | Bytes | md5 |
  |---|---|---|
  | `include/glad/gl.h` | 884,808 | `7153ab725863885bf634d96145f63368` |
  | `include/KHR/khrplatform.h` | 11,131 | `5825532bbe1f36a4bb04da1e823a847b` |
  | `src/gl.c` | 616,834 | `af7c1959ce6d2cec9378037efe467de8` |

  Re-generating with the command line above on 2026-10-07 reproduced all three files byte for byte
  (identical md5s), so the tree here is exactly what the recorded command emits.

- License: glad2's generated output is `(WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0` (see the SPDX lines at the
  head of `gl.h` and `gl.c`); `KHR/khrplatform.h` is the Khronos Group's MIT-style platform header.
- Include root: `vendor/glad/include`. `glad/gl.h` nests `#include <KHR/khrplatform.h>`, so a single
  include directory exposes both.

**How this copy is built.** These files are compiled **directly into the `beatdrop-render-gl` target**
from the root `CMakeLists.txt` — `src/gl.c` is listed in `BEATDROP_RENDER_GL_SOURCES` and there is no
`add_subdirectory(vendor/glad)`. The same shape `vendor/hlslparser/PROJECTM-PIN.md` describes: the
vendor tree is kept for provenance and consumed by the target that needs it, rather than configured
as its own project.

**`src/gl.c` is compiled as C++** (root `CMakeLists.txt`: `set_source_files_properties(... PROPERTIES
LANGUAGE CXX)`), for two reasons. This tree tracks no other `.c` file and deliberately forces
`CMAKE_C_FLAGS` to `""`, so a C compilation path would introduce a language with no flag discipline
here; and glad2 2.0.8's `gl.c` is C++-safe (0 designated initializers, 0 compound literals) while
`glad/gl.h` wraps its declarations in `extern "C"`, so C++ compilation preserves C linkage.
`gladLoadGL(GLADloadfunc)` / `gladLoadGLUserPtr` remain the entry points — this is glad2, not glad1's
`gladLoadGLLoader`.

## OpenGL ES 3.0 loader (GLES-002)

The `gles` backend (`SYNESTHESIA_VIBE_BACKEND=gles`: iOS, Android) uses a second glad2 loader
generated by the same **glad2 2.0.8**, here with the macOS system CPython 3.9.6 on 2026-10-11.

- Command line, verbatim:

  ```
  python3 -m venv <scratch>/glad2/v
  <scratch>/glad2/v/bin/python -m pip install glad2==2.0.8
  <scratch>/glad2/v/bin/python -m glad --reproducible --quiet --api gles2=3.0 --out-path <scratch>/glad2/gen-gles c
  ```

- Specification pin: `--api gles2=3.0` — OpenGL ES 3.0, the floor of every iOS 13 device and of the
  Android `GLESv3` link. **No `--extensions` flag was passed**; the generator's default extension
  set applies (`Extensions: 320`, `include/glad/gles2.h` line 8).
- Generated files, copied verbatim with no local modification (LF line endings):

  | Path | Bytes | md5 |
  |---|---|---|
  | `include/glad/gles2.h` | 321,867 | `3d0dc5b07bd5e8ef420b9ccae7f569fd` |
  | `src/gles2.c` | 212,584 | `38ab1154ff9382e6998ce752899a3d5c` |

  The run also emits `include/KHR/khrplatform.h`, byte-identical to the copy already vendored
  (`5825532bbe1f36a4bb04da1e823a847b`), so it was not re-copied.
- Cross-check: the same venv re-running the desktop command above (`--api gl:core=3.3`) reproduces
  `include/glad/gl.h` and `src/gl.c` byte for byte against the LF files in git (md5
  `262fd546557e68221b45666198ed9798` / `f71828de707ecb9e85ad168ad70c9d8e`; the md5s in the table
  above were taken from a CRLF Windows checkout).

**Selection.** Exactly one loader is compiled per build: the root `CMakeLists.txt` puts `src/gles2.c`
in `BEATDROP_RENDER_GL_SOURCES` when `SYNESTHESIA_VIBE_BACKEND=gles` and `src/gl.c` otherwise (never
both — `GlFunctionsLoaded()` reads whichever function table the included header names), and compiles
it as C++ for the same reasons as `gl.c`. `src/render/gl/gl_headers.h` includes `<glad/gles2.h>`
under `SYNESTHESIA_VIBE_GLES` and `<glad/gl.h>` otherwise; `render_gl::LoadGlFunctions` calls
`gladLoadGLES2UserPtr` / `gladLoadGLUserPtr` to match.
